verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents a public AppSec Platform API for listing deployments, findings, and projects (semgrep-docs-17), and the CLI is fully documented and scriptable (semgrep-docs-19, semgrep-docs-27, semgrep-probe-4), giving AI-native users programmatic ways to drive scans and retrieve results. However, no OpenAPI/swagger spec is discoverable (semgrep-probe-2 shows 404s across standard paths), and the API's scope appears limited to read-mostly operations rather than full control over rule authoring, triage, or configuration. Missing for 10: a formal API reference/spec (OpenAPI schema), broader write/management endpoints, and independent developer confirmation of API robustness.
